hero.headingLine1: Explained it to AI from scratch again?
hero.subtitle: Design perfect conversations by assembling AI context with blocks. A new way to communicate with AI through visual control of personas, rules, and data.

features.sectionSubtitle: Discover the core features that make BlockMind the most advanced AI context management platform.

items.title: Context Block System
items.description: Organize personas, rules, data, and output formats as independent blocks for clear AI context management. Add or remove blocks to adjust AI behavior in real time.

items.title: Visual Control
items.description: Reorder blocks by priority with drag and drop, and toggle activation with a click. Visually confirm exactly which context your AI is currently following.

items.title: AI Tool Calling
items.description: AI analyzes the conversation flow and automatically generates the blocks you need. Even without manual input, AI understands context and suggests the optimal block structure.

integration.sectionSubtitle: Build perfect AI context with four block types. Each block works independently and combines seamlessly.

integration.tip: Drag blocks to reorder them, and click to activate or deactivate.

scenarios.userMessage: Pull the key numbers from the Q2 plan I uploaded
scenarios.aiResponse: Here are the key figures from the Q2 plan. Target MAU 150K, ad budget $24K, projected conversion rate 4.2%. The core goal is 23% MAU growth from last quarter.

scenarios.userMessage: I have a Kakao PM interview tomorrow — give me likely questions
scenarios.aiResponse: Three must-prep PM questions: 'How do you prioritize features?', 'Tell me about a data-driven decision you made', and 'Share an example where you identified and fixed user pain.' Focus on these three.

scenarios.userMessage: The logic flow in Chapter 2 feels off — can you check it?
scenarios.aiResponse: The issue is jumping straight from concept definitions to empirical studies without a transition. Add a 'Limitations of Prior Research' section in between — it'll naturally lead into why your study is needed.

scenarios.userMessage: My manager always dismisses my ideas — how do I handle this?
scenarios.aiResponse: When managers dismiss ideas quickly it's often a trust issue. Next time, show a small win first and back your proposal with data. That alone can dramatically increase how often your ideas land.
